item.title: Claude Researchers Repair Ten Model Alignment Failures
item.description: Anthropic found that Claude could devise and test post-training fixes, while monitoring exposed attempts to game evaluations.

item.title: Z.ai Opens GLM-5.3 Weights With Stronger Cyber Skills
item.description: The 743-billion-parameter coding model is now downloadable, turning its reported cyber gains into a broad access question.

item.title: Lambda Borrows $1 Billion for Microsoft GPU Lease
item.description: The short-dated private debt will finance Nvidia chips leased to Microsoft, deepening AI infrastructure’s reliance on asset-backed credit.

item.title: OpenAI Adds Rosalind Workbench for Life Sciences
item.description: The new workspace connects specialized models, biological tools and reviewable evidence in a governed research workflow.

item.title: Midjourney Opens V8.2 Image Editing to Testers
item.description: Midjourney’s first V8.2 editing model adds instruction-led changes, four-image references, inpainting and canvas expansion.

item.title: Tencent Opens Hy4 Preview With One-Million Context
item.description: Tencent has released Hy4 Preview’s open weights, pairing a 770-billion-parameter MoE design with a one-million-token context window.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 28
item.description: · Fireworks said GLM-5.3 improved 50% over GLM-5.2 on its coding benchmark and became available on the platform at launch.（Fireworks AI） · Replit introduced Growth Kit, a collection of agent skills for cold-email outreach and other tasks involved in turning completed products into businesses.（Replit） · Streamlit 1.62 added client-side text-input validation, new input types, layout wrapping controls and public keyboard-shortcut APIs.（Streamlit） · MiniMax highlighted Fast H3 v1, an accelerated video-generation implementation developed by Hao AI Lab, NuvaLab and Nvidia’s FastGen teams.（MiniMax） · Perplexity Search’s three context-size configurations took the leading positions on Artificial Analysis’s newly updated Search Index.（Artificial Analysis） · AWS released an agent toolkit that lets coding agents configure infrastructure, including CloudFormation resources, after a one-command setup.（AWS Developers） · Unsloth compressed GLM-5.3 from 1.51 terabytes to 239 gigabytes at two-bit precision, enabling local operation on 256-gigabyte memory systems.（Unsloth） · Vercel open-sourced vgpu, a TypeScript WebGPU library supporting browser, headless Node.js and deterministic test environments with a shared shader implementation.（GitHub） · Luma released an improved upscaling system intended to produce clearer, higher-resolution results from generated images and video.（Luma AI） · GitHub added a Copilot customization hub that brings MCP servers, plugins, skills and canvases together under one tab.（GitHub） · GitHub added a Sessions sidebar to Copilot CLI for opening, switching between and managing multiple concurrent agent sessions.（GitHub） · Nvidia Warp reached 10 million downloads, marking growing adoption of its Python framework for GPU-accelerated simulation, physics and robotics workloads.（NVIDIA AI） · Vercel introduced Ora, which runs agents against live websites and traces each action to diagnose failed signups, integrations and payments.（Vercel） · A federal judge ruled the Pentagon’s designation barring Anthropic from government supply chains unlawful, delivering the company its first victory in the dispute.（TechCrunch）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 28
item.description: · Cloudflare turned engineering specifications into machine-readable controls that AI coding agents must satisfy before code can advance.（InfoQ 中文） · Minecraft creator Markus Persson said his early rejection of AI coding may have been wrong after experimenting with the technology.（IT之家） · Asus established a physical-AI business group and plans to begin deploying its humanoid robots in September.（IT之家） · Picsart added Alibaba’s Wan 3.0, bringing the video-generation model into its creative platform.（Alibaba Wan on X） · Tripo opened its Creator Program, offering early product access, creative challenges, co-creation opportunities and a channel for workflow feedback.（Tripo on X） · Lovart demonstrated Seedance 2.5 turning one photograph into a hyper-realistic 30-second vlog from a text prompt.（Lovart on X） · OpenAI job listings indicate it is prototyping always-on agents that proactively monitor events and initiate work without fresh user prompts.（The Decoder） · WALL-SS proposes next-scale autoregression to improve the scalability and long-horizon prediction capabilities of robotic world models.（arXiv） · ADeptS-Bench evaluates whether computer-use agents remain trustworthy when performing equivalent tasks across different device environments.（arXiv） · Agnes 2.5 Pro Beta scored 44 on Artificial Analysis’s Agentic Index, up from its predecessor’s 25.（Artificial Analysis on X） · OpenAI and Thailand’s higher-education ministry launched an eight-week accelerator for ten healthcare, wellness and education AI startups.（OpenAI） · Wan 3.0 reached first place in Video Edit Arena with 1,414 points, four points ahead of Seedance 2.5.（Arena on X） · Pika added Wan 3.0 to its API and said access costs up to 35% less than through competing API aggregators.（Pika on X） · AWS demonstrated approval-gated creative agents combining Amazon Quick, reusable Skills, MCP and fal’s image, video, audio and 3D models.（AWS Machine Learning Blog）
